summary: HAL Laboratory and Nintendo's long-running action-platform series and spinoff family, covering the main Dream Land line, remakes, racing, puzzle, touch, free-to-start, and Switch-era entries.

entries.title: Kirby's Dream Land

emulation.notes: Use accurate Game Boy emulation if not using Nintendo Switch Online.

entries.remaster_caveats: Players seeking the exact NES game should use the Nintendo Switch Online or 3D Classics version instead.
